closeGame: Close STFC when convenient. Daystrom will finish switching to the previous mod version automatically, and it will take effect the next time you start the game.
finishingMod: Daystrom is preparing the previous mod version for the next game start.
description: Daystrom and its bundled mod will return to the previous verified version, {{version}}.
runningGame: STFC stays open. A mod already loaded by the running game changes only after the game is closed and started again.
verifying: Verifying the previous version's package and settings…
installing: Returning to the previous version and restarting Daystrom…
none: No verified previous Daystrom release is available.
